description: Add automated unit tests for important logic in an existing frontend or backend project.
requirements: Repository should include a configured test framework such as Jest, Vitest, Pytest, JUnit, xUnit or Jasmine
At least five meaningful unit tests should be present
Tests should cover success and failure scenarios
README.md should include the command required to run tests
Submitted repository should include evidence that tests pass through a test report, CI run or documented command output
title: Add Unit Tests
